name: Carrier-based home console
definition: home console on which the owner loads different games from a carrier, card, download or storage.

name: Dedicated home console
definition: home console with built-in games that the owner cannot load (includes plug-and-play minis).

name: Carrier-based handheld
definition: handheld in which games are loaded, not built in; the operating system is an attribute, so a handheld gaming PC is a named form of this kind with os = PC.

name: Hybrid console
definition: console that works both docked to a TV and as a handheld.

name: Dedicated LCD handheld
definition: handheld with its game built in on an LCD.

name: Standalone VR or mixed-reality headset
definition: headset that encloses the eyes and has its own compute and battery.

name: Tethered VR headset
definition: headset that encloses the eyes and needs a console or PC as its host (host platform is an attribute).

name: Upright cabinet
definition: coin-operated video arcade cabinet that stands upright, played standing.

name: Cabaret (mini) cabinet
definition: smaller upright coin-operated video cabinet.

name: Cocktail table cabinet
definition: coin-operated video cabinet built as a table, played seated across or beside it.

name: Sit-down cabinet (candy cabinet)
definition: coin-operated video cabinet with a seat for the player.

name: Cockpit or environmental cabinet
definition: enclosed or motion cabinet built around the player.

name: Counter-top or bar-top cabinet
definition: small cabinet made to stand on a counter or bar.

name: Disk-drive add-on
definition: unit that adds a disk drive to a console.

name: Cartridge converter
definition: unit that lets a console play cartridges of another system or region.

name: Gamepad
definition: hand-held controller with a directional pad, buttons and sticks or triggers, held in both hands.

name: Detachable split controller
definition: controller made as two detachable halves that can be used apart.

name: Levered arcade stick
definition: arcade-style controller with a joystick lever and buttons.

name: Racing wheel
definition: steering-wheel controller for driving games.

name: Pedal set
definition: set of foot pedals sold as a controller.

name: Light gun
definition: gun-shaped pointing controller.

name: Motion controller
definition: controller that senses its own movement in the player's hand.

name: Console camera
definition: camera made to track the player as game input.

name: Rhythm instrument controller
definition: controller shaped like a musical instrument, made to control a game.

name: Dance or balance mat
definition: floor mat or board that reads the player's steps or weight as game input.

name: Leverless (all-button) controller
definition: arcade-style controller with all-button directional input and no lever.

name: Case or pouch
definition: case or pouch made to hold or protect one game machine.

name: Screen protector film
definition: film for the screen of one game machine.

name: Battery pack made for one machine
definition: rechargeable battery pack made for one game machine or controller.

name: AC adapter
definition: power adapter made for one game machine.

name: Charging stand or dock (charging only)
definition: stand or dock that only charges the machine or controller.

name: Proprietary cable or adapter
definition: cable or adapter with a proprietary connector made for one console.

name: Proprietary memory card or expansion
definition: memory card, drive or expansion in a format made only for one console.

name: TV dock
definition: dock that gives video output to a TV as well as charging.

name: Stand or mount
definition: stand or mount made to hold one game machine.
